text:
Rhea Kapoor: Quick thread  proposal for a staged PLG launch loop experiment: short launch post -> 10-min benchmark webinar -> adaptive credit ladder + onboarding coaching nudges. keep it small and iterative.
Jonah Miller: Nice. what's the single hypothesis?
Rhea Kapoor: hypothesis: combining a persuasive benchmark narrative + a live micro-webinar will raise template adoption and shorten time-to-first-successful-response vs credits-only. adaptive credits reward concrete actions not just signups.
Maya Lopez: love the adaptive piece. suggest 4 arms, N=640: (A) post+webinar+adaptive credits, (B) post+adaptive credits, (C) flat credit on signup, (D) control.
Samir Patel: routing question  how do users get funneled into webinar vs credits? need clear traffic rules and caps.
Rhea Kapoor: routing idea: utm=bench_webinar -> priority to A, paid-social -> randomize among A/B/C, organic -> randomized across all arms. cap webinar seats at 360/week; overflow -> waitlist + auto $5 consolation.
Maya Lopez: onboarding treatment for A: after signup show a 3-step "coaching" modal that (1) highlights a benchmark stat, (2) surfaces 3 curated templates, (3) offers a 1-click run. Flag name `mkt/bench_coach_v1`. canary to 60.
ops-bot: created flag mkt/bench_coach_v1 (canary=60) :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: tracking events I'll add: launch_post_view, bench_webinar_invite, bench_webinar_attended, coach_shown, template_tried, credit_awarded, first_success_response. also tag campaign_source and cohort_id on events.
Jonah Miller: metrics: pct_try_template_7d, median_time_to_first_success, pct_repeat_use_14d, 30d_net_revenue. early-signal alerts at 48h for template_try_rate and first_success_rate.
Rhea Kapoor: adaptive credit logic: $5 on first template try, $15 if user gets a first-successful-response within 24h, $25 extra if they try 3 unique templates within 7d. webinar attendance gives an immediate $10 bonus. no stacking beyond $40 cap.
Maya Lopez: UX ask  make credit redemption obvious in post-signup banner and replay email. replay should include the benchmark narrative snippet: "ACME cut prompt tokens 2.8x with templates" and a one-click try.
Samir Patel: analytics note: event names -> bench_replay_played, bench_narrative_read, template_card_clicked. I'll add dashboards and conversion funnels per arm.
Rhea Kapoor: experiment config draft below. please react with :thumbsup: if good.
```yaml
experiment_id: bench_loop_adaptive_1988
cohort_size: 640
arms:
  - name: post_webinar_adaptive
    webinar_invite: true
    adaptive_credit: true
  - name: post_adaptive
    webinar_invite: false
    adaptive_credit: true
  - name: flat_credit
    webinar_invite: false
    flat_credit_usd: 30
  - name: control
    webinar_invite: false
    flat_credit_usd: 0
metrics:
  - pct_try_template_7d
  - median_time_to_first_success
  - pct_repeat_use_14d
traffic_rules:
  - if: utm==bench_webinar -> assign:post_webinar_adaptive
  - if: source==paid_social -> random_assign(post_webinar_adaptive, post_adaptive, flat_credit)
  - else: random_assign(all_arms)
credit_rules:
  - first_template_try: $5
  - first_success_within_24h: $15
  - three_unique_templates_within_7d: $25
  - webinar_attendance_bonus: $10
  - max_credit_cap_per_user: $40
```
Maya Lopez: owners: landing & benchmark copy = Maya, webinar slides + short demo = Rhea, FF + onboarding push = ops (Jonah to verify FF wiring), analytics = Samir, credits ops = finance-ops.
Jonah Miller: I'll create the flag, canary to 60 and wire the onboarding modal. ops-bot, please create rollout ticket.
ops-bot: ticket created: rollout/mkt/bench_coach_v1 -> canary=60 -> owners=@jonah.miller :white_check_mark:
finance-ops: tagged to validate adaptive credit flow and anti-abuse checks. can finance-ops confirm availability and rate-limits?
finance-ops: confirmed budget ok for a $40 cap, will add promo abuse detection and redemption limits.
Rhea Kapoor: timeline: landing + benchmark copy by Mon EOD, FF canary Tue AM, webinar slides Tue PM, launch Wed AM. small runbook 15-min Tue 9am to finalize.
Samir Patel: will produce dashboards and baseline cohort metrics by Tue noon.
Maya Lopez: final note  keep comms tight: headline the benchmark stat, show 10-min webinar RSVP, make credits action-oriented. any objections?
Jonah Miller: :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: :thumbsup:
Maya Lopez: booking runbook. :rocket:
